description: This Java class implements a TCP server for the rusEfi console, acting as a proxy that listens on port 2390, handling binary protocol commands and forwarding data between a client and the internal binary protocol handler. It manages incoming socket connections, reads commands, and sends responses based on the protocol defined by rusEfi.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolServer
classes.description: Implements a TCP server that proxies binary protocol commands for rusEfi, handling connections, parsing commands, and communicating with the binary protocol.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the TCP server in a new thread, listens for incoming connections, and spawns threads for each client connection.

methods.name: runProxy
methods.description: Handles the proxy logic for a single client socket, reading commands, processing data, and sending responses according to the protocol.

methods.name: swap16
methods.description: Swaps the byte order of a 16-bit short value for protocol compatibility.
